adasOptional: Adaptive cruise assist with stop-and-go, top-view camera, high-beam assist (bundled in Convenience / Driver Assistance packages on Premium Plus). Source: https://www.edmunds.com/audi/a3/2025/

sideViewCameraNotes: Data unavailable: no side-blind / 360-surround camera at Premium trim level (Premium Plus optional via package).
subscriptionFeatures: Audi connect CARE / PLUS / Navigation tiers after trial; Function on Demand may unlock select infotainment options (e.g., MMI Navigation plus if equipped hardware) on monthly/annual/lifetime plans. drmNotes: Vehicle drives normally without active myAudi/Audi connect subscription. Connected services (remote lock, remote start, emergency call, navigation traffic) require an Audi connect plan after the trial period. OTA updates apply to infotainment. killSwitchNotes: No US federal impaired-driving-detection kill switch is installed in MY2025; NHTSA's IIJA rule is not yet final. knownIssues: Audi-brand-wide infotainment glitches and software bugs are the most-cited Consumer Reports issue. A3-specific complaints in the 4th-gen MQB-evo platform are limited but the brand's JD Power 2025 IQS last-place finish (269 PP100) reflects elevated first-90-day defect rates. Sources: https://www.motor1.com/news/764216/audi-last-jd-power-initial-quality-study-2025/ ; https://www.consumerreports.org/cars/audi/a3/2025/road-test-report/
recalls: Data unavailable: no MY2025-specific A3 recalls surfaced in NHTSA Recalls.gov search at time of writing; consult NHTSA by VIN before purchase.
stateIncentives: Data unavailable: MHEV mild-hybrids are generally not eligible for state EV incentives (CA CVRP, CO Innovative Motor Vehicle Credit, etc., all require plug-in capability).
